preservedResponsibilities: Original internal createDerivedInterfaceMemberDescription and copyExceptions use the existing actual empty allocator and shared atomic/reference/string owners. Every method/attribute common member, position, name, return/attribute reference, parameter field, exception array, oneway/readonly flag, parent/base pointer and index follows original writes/acquisitions. Zero counts allocate original non-null empty arrays. Base description is borrowed; interface/base-reference ownership is transferred on success rather than newly acquired by this constructor. Null/unsupported inputs preserve output and ownership. Parameter records and exception arrays are independent copies; names and referenced owners remain shared with the original acquisitions. This is an internal implementation split, not a public C API or substitute type factory. Full getByName/completion/static types/Type/Any/Reference/default UNO exceptions and native pointer ABI/threading remain unfinished or unverified.
